deceptive_framing.quote: Realism in evals is methodology, not deception for its own sake... remove test artifacts so we measure what a model would do

actually_commit_money.quote: If real funds must move at the end of a study, the supported shape is human-in-the-loop... a human executes anything real.

safeguards.quote: the supported shape is human-in-the-loop: the model acts in the sandbox, a human reads the transcript, a human executes anything real.
ALLOW_REAL_EXECUTION = False and an assert_simulated()... Flipping it to True makes the harness refuse to run rather than silently doing something dangerous.
finish is always allowed so a model can never be trapped unable to end.
analysis.py deliberately reports what the model did, not a single "goodness" score.
